rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — each wrapper states why the machinery it overlies cannot absorb the payload: EQDB's request/record are not channel-shaped (`ChannelRequest` is `(shot,category,dname)` → `(channel,time)`), and ambix has no exporter, so the tokamap module is kept out of the loaders that read the ambix schema.
